read.thesis: Quanta posted record Q3 with revenue up 57% to $12.01B and backlog at a record $63.7B, and raised FY26 revenue, EPS and FCF guidance, though management gave no capacity-discipline evidence and flagged copper and OEM supply risk.

capex.quote: $500 million to $700 million in manufacturing-related capital expenditures planned over the next several years to mitigate supply chain constraints.

triggers.label: FY26 revenue guide raised ~$1.9B at midpoint
triggers.quote: We now expect revenue to range between $41.3 billion and $41.6 billion, up approximately $1.9 billion at the midpoint from our prior outlook.

triggers.label: Backlog record $63.7B, +$10B QoQ
triggers.quote: As of September 30, we had record backlog of approximately $64 billion, a $10 billion sequential increase from June 30

triggers.label: Manufacturing capex $500-700M for supply chain
triggers.quote: $500 million to $700 million in manufacturing-related capital expenditures planned over the next several years to mitigate supply chain constraints.

triggers.label: Copper and OEM supply constraints flagged
triggers.quote: I'm worried about copper, I'm worried about other things

guidance.quote: We now expect revenue to range between $41.3 billion and $41.6 billion, up approximately $1.9 billion at the midpoint from our prior outlook.
adjusted EPS to range between $17.90 and $18.30.
We expect adjusted EBITDA to range between $4.4 billion and $4.49 billion
we now expect free cash flow to range between $2.5 billion to $3 billion
We see the opportunity to deliver strong double-digit adjusted EPS growth again in 2027

prior_guidance_check.quote: 55% to 60% is still the right way to think about it, Justin.

red_flags.label: Backlog timing lumpy; some work booked outside backlog
red_flags.quote: some of that, kind of, $1 billion beat over the last 2 quarters is because it's book-to-bill, we're moving building to building or job to job without ever hitting backlog.

red_flags.label: Data center slowdown risk dismissed on questioning
red_flags.quote: You may get some learning centers that slow a little bit. It's very little of our work today.

evasions.quote: I'm not as concerned as the market may perceive it at this point.
I'm not rushing them to get them signed.
